description: Presses a button on the modal dialog SOLIDWORKS is showing, or closes it. Answered even while the dialog holds SOLIDWORKS' UI thread. When the dialog belonged to a running request, waits for that request's outcome.

dialog.description: The dialog id, from a dialog_open error or addin.state.

button.description: A button's text (case and & ignored), its control id, or close.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the outcome of the request the dialog belonged to, 0 to 60000 ms; 5000 when absent.
